issue_context.body:
# Support Reorganize Partition Dev Task

Related Issues: #15000
Design PR:
- [x] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/38246

## Dev Tasks
- [x] Parser support
- [x] Copy records, #38460
- [x] Recreate the indexes in the new partitions, #38460
- [x] Double write data in foreground sessions (concurrent DML during DDL), #38508
- [x] Handle `reorganize partition` command in ddl_api.go and ddl.go, #40473
- [x] Error handling and DDL rollback, #40543
- [x] Delete range of old partitions, #40543
- [x] Update Table handling, #40714
- [ ] TiFlash handling, #40715
- [x] Add telemetry for reorganize partition, #40258
- [x] Support in TiFlash https://github.com/pingcap/tiflash/issues/6444
- [x] Support in TiCDC https://github.com/pingcap/tiflow/pull/8114

review_comments:
Should we just remove this comment, or rename it to something like `doneKey`? 

@tangenta @zimulala
It is fine to remove the comment.
Right, it should have been removed in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/38738, when it was changed.

So this will just write stats as all zeros / empty table/indexes. Preferably I think it should trigger stats on the new partitions, including their indexes as well as update the global stats. And also wait for all this during the DeleteReorganization phase, so stats are up-to-date when going to StatePublic where the stats will be needed.
